text:
Elena Torres: :megaphone: Quick update for on-prem/VPC customers: were updating our recommended auto-update policy for on-prem installers to include an emergency-patch channel and signed-delivery verification. This affects air-gapped installs and customers who previously disabled automatic updates. Outline below.

Marcus Li: Reason? Is this tied to a specific CVE?

Elena Torres: Yes were rolling a critical patch addressing CVE-2026-0432 (token rewrap race in older runtimes). Patching path: auto-update (preferred), signed offline bundle (air-gapped), or manual patch apply.

Ravi Singh: For air-gapped customers, what changes in practice?

Elena Torres: Two things: 1) well publish signed patch bundles to our secure bucket and provide a verification tool (redwood-verify) for checksum + signature validation. 2) Were introducing an "emergency-patch" update channel that SRE can enable per-customer when an urgent fix is needed. No silent installs for air-gapped without explicit customer approval.

Jordan Lee: Any customer-facing comms planned? We should give clear steps and a short timeline.

Priya Rao: CS template and FAQ are in progress. High-level timeline: advisory published today, optional auto-update enablement window opens in 7 days, emergency channel available immediately for critical incidents, enforcement of patch policy for new on-prem installs in 60 days.

Marcus Li: Ops notes: auto-update defaults remain off for pre-existing customers unless they opt-in. For customers who do enable auto-update, the default schedule is weekly with a low-risk window (Sat 03:00-05:00 UTC). Well add a dry-run flag for first-run deployments.

Ravi Singh: Security notes: bundles are signed with our new OTA signing key (KMS: projects/infra/keys/ota-sign-2026). Verification command:

```
redwood-verify --bundle /tmp/redwood-patch.tar.gz --signature /tmp/patch.sig
# expected: signature=OK, checksum=match, upgrade_plan=NO_BREAKING_CHANGES
```

Elena Torres: For the on-prem installer weve added a preflight that simulates the upgrade and reports potential conflicts:

```
redwoodctl onprem preflight-upgrade --bundle /path/to/bundle
# outputs: impact: low, services_restart: ['scheduler'], downtime_est: 20s
```

Jordan Lee: Action items for CS/PM: prepare an opt-in flow, and a fallback opt-out page. We should also include instructions for partners who manage upgrades on behalf of customers.

Priya Rao: Compliance: Ravi, can you confirm how this interacts with FIPS/HSM deployments? We must not expose private keys when generating bundles for air-gapped customers.

Ravi Singh: Confirmed. For HSM-backed environments we only ship signed metadata and a delta binary; customers rewrap/sign locally. The doc appendix covers HSM procedures.

DevSec Bot: Emergency patch release: patch-2026-0432 signed and published at 2026-06-11T14:12Z. Offline bundle link: https://internal.redwood/secure/patches/patch-2026-0432.tar.gz (access controls applied).

Marcus Li: Monitoring: adding dashboard tiles for upgrade success rate, verification failures, and post-upgrade service health. Also adding an alert for verification-failures > 1% in a batch.

Elena Torres: Customer impact: minimal for most. Air-gapped customers will need to fetch the bundle and run redwood-verify + redwoodctl onprem apply-bundle. Doc: https://docs.internal.redwood/onprem/auto-update-policy-2026.

Jordan Lee: Draft customer advisory: https://docs.internal.redwood/cs/advisories/onprem-patch-2026-0432. Will ping for review.

Priya Rao: Enforcement note: new installs must opt into the signed-delivery verification by default (can be disabled per contract). Enforcement date for default verification: 2026-08-01.

Ravi Singh: SRE support: we can offer assisted bundle application for enterprise customers for the first 30 days post-release. Please route requests via support with tag "assisted-patch".

Elena Torres: TL;DR action list:
- Engineering: release signed bundles + verification tool (Marcus/Ravi)
- Onprem Docs: publish preflight + HSM appendix (Elena)
- CS: advisory + opt-in flow (Jordan)
- Ops: add dashboards and schedule low-risk windows (Marcus)
- Support: assisted patch SKUs + routing (Priya)

DevSec Bot: Patch rollout summary: canary-1 applied 2026-06-12T03:00Z (success), canary-2 applied 2026-06-12T06:00Z (verification failure - missing sig). Issue tracked: 1825060001.

Jordan Lee: Noted. Ill include opt-out instructions and the assisted-patch contact in the advisory.

Elena Torres: Thanks everyone. Reopen thread if we need to escalate to exec comms. :white_check_mark:
